name: Replication Data for "Social network shrinking is explained by active and passive effects but not increasing selectivity with age in wild macaques"

description: Replication data for analyses in a publication. Longterm behavioral observations on activity and social behavior of wild Assamese macaques at Phu Khio Wildlife Sanctuary with R code for statistical analyses of longitudinal and cross-sectional age effects on behavior.
